svg.title: Jenab — app structure (SPEC v0.6)
svg.text: Open-source Go + Wails v3 desktop agent harness · design stage · components from SPEC.md v0.4 and PROPOSAL.md §5
React + TypeScript · shadcn/ui · Zustand · TanStack Table · Recharts · Bun

g.text: Chat (full, or docked beside an open page)
Streamed replies · tool calls · previews with refs
Undo turn · Refresh memory (chip, diff, undo)
rows of blocks: table · chart · pie · stat · form
Project settings · run log · update notice

svg.text: v3.0.0-beta.26, pinned tag · normal OS window frame (SPIKE-003)
bindings (Go calls) · events (streams, async results) · asset handler /objects/<project_id>/<key> · tray + background mode · notifications · single instance
one process · pure Go, no cgo (modernc.org/sqlite) · time/tzdata embedded

g.text: system prompt → user memory → project memory
tool output: preview + ref; stub after a cut
Main agent: chat + tools, edits memory and notes
Schema agent: returns structured migration steps
only main agents (and the user) write memory
owns the agent loop, one turn at a time
writes message + tool_call to chats.db first
every change logged · Undo turn · Revert run
undo lists conflicts; migrations not undone
memory/run updates → notice in current turn
no LLM, no network on open
dry run on a VACUUM INTO copy

svg.text: one writer goroutine + reader pool per db file

g.text: no read tx longer than timeout
Anthropic + OpenAI SDKs; local models via base URL
complete streams only · truncation check · retries
search: Tavily · Brave · SearXNG · feeds · GDELT
pages: charset → main content → Markdown → bucket
ed25519-signed releases · https feed · fails closed
checks at start + every 6 h · restarts only when idle
per-user install, no admin · watchdog relaunch

svg.text: one per project (ULID) · jenab.lock while open · export via VACUUM INTO
Every .db runs in WAL mode · project.db and chats.db each get their own writer and reader pool · not in v1: remote bucket backends, event triggers, parallel branches, team access
